payload.body: First full gate completed on frozen source. Build passed. Lint failed seven existing-rule complexity/function-length diagnostics; npm test and coverage failed eleven migration/IPC/preload expectations (13626 tests passed,57 skipped); typecheck failed an unsupported reader ChatRole fixture; deadcode reported three module-local exported types. Evidence retained under Temp/dm838-gates-1795202400, no unchanged-source reruns. Independent review additionally found restart invalidation for unavailable folders, eager DB-open startup failure, missing combined-capability audit, missing workflow target identifiers and separate-submitter Kanban usage loss. These original-scope defects are accepted for causal correction with failing consumer regressions first. Worker has source freeze release; final gate will exercise corrected source, not erase previous failures. Initial lifecycle and retro tests were red-first; later native/CLI/UI expansions were not all independently red-first, a chronology limitation that cannot be retroactively claimed fixed. No real grant elevated; final actual desktop images and native person decision are still pending. No completion or passing criterion is claimed by this note.
